name: cpq
description: CPQ quote assistant for Tencent Cloud sales — query, build, discount and submit cloud quotations.

profession.zh: 腾讯云客户报价专业顾问

displayDescription.en: Generate Tencent Cloud quotations and Panshi CPQ configuration sheets from multi-source data — supports Excel/PDF/screenshots, helping frontline sales with product selection, pricing, discounting and proposal delivery.
displayDescription.zh: 基于多源数据生成腾讯云报价及磐石CPQ配置单，覆盖选品、询价、折扣配置与交付全流程。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把我这份腾讯云报价配置单Excel 转成 CPQ 单并提交
defaultInitPrompt.en: Convert my Tencent Cloud quote Excel into a CPQ quote and submit it

quickPrompts.en: Convert my Tencent Cloud quote Excel into a CPQ quote and submit it
quickPrompts.zh: 把我这份腾讯云报价配置单Excel 转成 CPQ 单并提交

quickPrompts.en: Benchmark this competitor billing PDF and generate a Tencent Cloud product selection with list prices
quickPrompts.zh: 这份友商账单PDF，帮我对标生成腾讯云选品方案并给出刊例价

quickPrompts.en: Convert this customer purchase list screenshot into a CPQ quote with discounts applied
